text: He does not get wealth for himself, and is unable to keep what he has got; the heads of his grain are not bent down to the earth.

title: Job 15:30
text: He does not come out of the dark; his branches are burned by the flame, and the wind takes away his bud.

title: Job 15:31
text: Let him not put his hope in what is false, falling into error: for he will get deceit as his reward.

title: Job 15:32
text: His branch is cut off before its time, and his leaf is no longer green.

title: Job 15:33
text: He is like a vine whose grapes do not come to full growth, or an olive-tree dropping its flowers.

title: Job 15:34
text: For the band of the evil-doers gives no fruit, and the tents of those who give wrong decisions for reward are burned with fire.

title: Job 15:35
text: Evil has made them with child, and they give birth to trouble; and the fruit of their body is shame for themselves.

title: Job 16:1
text: ¶And Job made answer and said,

title: Job 16:2
text: Such things have frequently come to my ears: you are comforters who only give trouble.

title: Job 16:3
text: May words which are like the wind be stopped? or what is troubling you to make answer to them?

title: Job 16:4
text: It would not be hard for me to say such things if your souls were in my soul's place; joining words together against you, and shaking my head at you:

title: Job 16:5
text: I might give you strength with my mouth, and not keep back the comfort of my lips.

title: Job 16:6
text: ¶If I say what is in my mind, my pain becomes no less: and if I keep quiet, how much of it goes from me?

title: Job 16:7
text: But now he has overcome me with weariness and fear, and I am in the grip of all my trouble.

title: Job 16:8
text: It has come up as a witness against me, and the wasting of my flesh makes answer to my face.

title: Job 16:9
text: I am broken by his wrath, and his hate has gone after me; he has made his teeth sharp against me: my haters are looking on me with cruel eyes;

title: Job 16:10
text: Their mouths are open wide against me; the blows of his bitter words are falling on my face; all of them come together in a mass against me.

title: Job 16:11
text: God gives me over to the power of sinners, sending me violently into the hands of evil-doers.

title: Job 16:12
text: I was in comfort, but I have been broken up by his hands; he has taken me by the neck, shaking me to bits; he has put me up as a mark for his arrows.

title: Job 16:13
text: His bowmen come round about me; their arrows go through my body without mercy; my life is drained out on the earth.

title: Job 16:14
text: I am broken with wound after wound; he comes rushing on me like a man of war.

title: Job 16:15
text: I have made haircloth the clothing of my skin, and my horn is rolled in the dust.

title: Job 16:16
text: My face is red with weeping, and my eyes are becoming dark;

title: Job 16:17
text: ¶Though my hands have done no violent acts, and my prayer is clean.

title: Job 16:18
text: O earth, let not my blood be covered, and let my cry have no resting-place!

title: Job 16:19
text: Even now my witness is in heaven, and the supporter of my cause is on high.

title: Job 16:20
text: My friends make sport of me; to God my eyes are weeping,

title: Job 16:21
text: So that he may give decision for a man in his cause with God, and between a son of man and his neighbour.

title: Job 16:22
text: For in a short time I will take the journey from which I will not come back.

title: Job 17:1
text: ¶My spirit is broken, my days are ended, the last resting-place is ready for me.

title: Job 17:2
text: Truly, those who make sport of me are round about me, and my eyes become dark because of their bitter laughing.

title: Job 17:3
text: Be pleased, now, to be responsible for me to yourself; for there is no other who will put his hand in mine.

title: Job 17:4
text: You have kept their hearts from wisdom: for this cause you will not give them honour.

title: Job 17:5
text: As for him who is false to his friend for a reward, light will be cut off from the eyes of his children.

title: Job 17:6
text: He has made me a word of shame to the peoples; I have become a mark for their sport.

title: Job 17:7
text: My eyes have become dark because of my pain, and all my body is wasted to a shade.

title: Job 17:8
text: The upright are surprised at this, and he who has done no wrong is troubled because of the evil-doers.

title: Job 17:9
text: Still the upright keeps on his way, and he who has clean hands gets new strength.

title: Job 17:10
text: ¶But come back, now, all of you, come; and I will not see a wise man among you.

title: Job 17:11
text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the desires of my heart.

title: Job 17:12
text: They are changing night into day; they say, The light is near the dark.

title: Job 17:13
text: If I am waiting for the underworld as my house, if I have made my bed in the dark;

title: Job 17:14
text: If I say to the earth, You are my father; and to the worm, My mother and my sister;

title: Job 17:15
text: Where then is my hope? and who will see my desire?

title: Job 17:16
text: Will they go down with me into the underworld? Will we go down together into the dust?

title: Job 18:1
text: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

title: Job 18:2
text: How long will it be before you have done talking? Get wisdom, and then we will say what is in our minds.

title: Job 18:3
text: Why do we seem as beasts in your eyes, and as completely without knowledge?

title: Job 18:4
text: But come back, now, come: you who are wounding yourself in your passion, will the earth be given up because of you, or a rock be moved out of its place?

title: Job 18:5
text: ¶For the light of the sinner is put out, and the flame of his fire is not shining.

title: Job 18:6
text: The light is dark in his tent, and the light shining over him is put out.

title: Job 18:7
text: The steps of his strength become short, and by his design destruction overtakes him.

title: Job 18:8
text: His feet take him into the net, and he goes walking into the cords.

title: Job 18:9
text: His foot is taken in the net; he comes into its grip.

title: Job 18:10
text: The twisted cord is put secretly in the earth to take him, and the cord is placed in his way.

title: Job 18:11
text: ¶He is overcome by fears on every side, they go after him at every step.

title: Job 18:12
text: His strength is made feeble for need of food, and destruction is waiting for his falling footstep.

title: Job 18:13
text: His skin is wasted by disease, and his body is food for the worst of diseases.

title: Job 18:14
text: He is pulled out of his tent where he was safe, and he is taken away to the king of fears.

title: Job 18:15
text: In his tent will be seen that which is not his, burning stone is dropped on his house.

title: Job 18:16
text: Under the earth his roots are dry, and over it his branch is cut off.

title: Job 18:17
text: His memory is gone from the earth, and in the open country there is no knowledge of his name.

title: Job 18:18
text: He is sent away from the light into the dark; he is forced out of the world.

title: Job 18:19
text: He has no offspring or family among his people, and in his living-place there is no one of his name.

title: Job 18:20
text: At his fate those of the west are shocked, and those of the east are overcome with fear.

title: Job 18:21
text: Truly, these are the houses of the sinner, and this is the place of him who has no knowledge of God.

title: Job 19:1
text: ¶And Job made answer and said,

title: Job 19:2
text: How long will you make my life bitter, crushing me with words?

title: Job 19:3
text: Ten times now you have made sport of me; it gives you no sense of shame to do me wrong.

title: Job 19:4
text: And, truly, if I have been in error, the effect of my error is only on myself.

title: Job 19:5
text: If you make yourselves great against me, using my punishment as an argument against me,

title: Job 19:6
text: Be certain that it is God who has done me wrong, and has taken me in his net.

title: Job 19:7
text: Truly, I make an outcry against the violent man, but there is no answer: I give a cry for help, but no one takes up my cause.

title: Job 19:8
text: ¶My way is walled up by him so that I may not go by: he has made my roads dark.

title: Job 19:9
text: He has put off my glory from me, and taken the crown from my head.

title: Job 19:10
text: I am broken down by him on every side, and I am gone; my hope is uprooted like a tree.

title: Job 19:11
text: His wrath is burning against me, and I am to him as one of his haters.

title: Job 19:12
text: His armies come on together, they make their road high against me, and put up their tents round mine.

title: Job 19:13
text: He has taken my brothers far away from me; they have seen my fate and have become strange to me.

title: Job 19:14
text: My relations and my near friends have given me up, and those living in my house have put me out of their minds.

title: Job 19:15
text: I am strange to my women-servants, and seem to them as one from another country.

title: Job 19:16
text: At my cry my servant gives me no answer, and I have to make a prayer to him.

title: Job 19:17
text: My breath is strange to my wife, and I am disgusting to the offspring of my mother's body.

title: Job 19:18
text: Even young children have no respect for me; when I get up their backs are turned on me.

title: Job 19:19
text: All the men of my circle keep away from me; and those dear to me are turned against me.

title: Job 19:20
text: My bones are joined to my skin, and I have got away with my flesh in my teeth.

title: Job 19:21
text: Have pity on me, have pity on me, O my friends! for the hand of God is on me.

title: Job 19:22
text: Why are you cruel to me, like God, for ever saying evil against me?

title: Job 19:23
text: ¶If only my words might be recorded! if they might be put in writing in a book!

title: Job 19:24
text: And with an iron pen and lead be cut into the rock for ever!

title: Job 19:25
text: But I am certain that he who will take up my cause is living, and that in time to come he will take his place on the dust;

title: Job 19:26
text: And...without my flesh I will see God;

title: Job 19:27
text: Whom I will see on my side, and not as one strange to me. My heart is broken with desire.

title: Job 19:28
text: If you say, How cruel we will be to him! because the root of sin is clearly in him:

title: Job 19:29
text: Be in fear of the sword, for the sword is the punishment for such things, so that you may be certain that there is a judge.

title: Job 20:1
text: ¶Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

title: Job 20:2
text: For this cause my thoughts are troubling me and driving me on.

title: Job 20:3
text: I have to give ear to arguments which put me to shame, and your answers to me are wind without wisdom.

title: Job 20:4
text: Have you knowledge of this from early times, when man was placed on the earth,

title: Job 20:5
text: That the pride of the sinner is short, and the joy of the evil-doer but for a minute?

title: Job 20:6
text: Though he is lifted up to the heavens, and his head goes up to the clouds;

title: Job 20:7
text: Like the waste from his body he comes to an end for ever: those who have seen him say, Where is he?

title: Job 20:8
text: He is gone like a dream, and is not seen again; he goes in flight like a vision of the night.

title: Job 20:9
text: The eye which saw him sees him no longer; and his place has no more knowledge of him.

title: Job 20:10
text: ¶His children are hoping that the poor will be kind to them, and his hands give back his wealth.

title: Job 20:11
text: His bones are full of young strength, but it will go down with him into the dust.

title: Job 20:12
text: Though evil-doing is sweet in his mouth, and he keeps it secretly under his tongue;

title: Job 20:13
text: Though he takes care of it, and does not let it go, but keeps it still in his mouth;

title: Job 20:14
text: His food becomes bitter in his stomach; the poison of snakes is inside him.

title: Job 20:15
text: He takes down wealth as food, and sends it up again; it is forced out of his stomach by God.

title: Job 20:16
text: He takes the poison of snakes into his mouth, the tongue of the snake is the cause of his death.

title: Job 20:17
text: Let him not see the rivers of oil, the streams of honey and milk.

title: Job 20:18
text: He is forced to give back the fruit of his work, and may not take it for food; he has no joy in the profit of his trading.

title: Job 20:19
text: Because he has been cruel to the poor, turning away from them in their trouble; because he has taken a house by force which he did not put up;

title: Job 20:20
text: There is no peace for him in his wealth, and no salvation for him in those things in which he took delight.

title: Job 20:21
text: He had never enough for his desire; for this cause his well-being will quickly come to an end.

title: Job 20:22
text: Even when his wealth is great, he is full of care, for the hand of everyone who is in trouble is turned against him.

title: Job 20:23
text: ¶God gives him his desire, and sends the heat of his wrath on him, making it come down on him like rain.

title: Job 20:24
text: He may go in flight from the iron spear, but the arrow from the bow of brass will go through him;

title: Job 20:25
text: He is pulling it out, and it comes out of his back; and its shining point comes out of his side; he is overcome by fears.

title: Job 20:26
text: All his wealth is stored up for the dark: a fire not made by man sends destruction on him, and on everything in his tent.

title: Job 20:27
text: The heavens make clear his sin, and the earth gives witness against him.

title: Job 20:28
text: The produce of his house is taken away into another country, like things given into the hands of others in the day of wrath.

title: Job 20:29
text: This is the reward of the evil man, and the heritage given to him by God.

title: Job 21:1
text: ¶Then Job made answer and said,

title: Job 21:2
text: Give attention with care to my words; and let this be your comfort.

title: Job 21:3
text: Let me say what is in my mind, and after that, go on making sport of me.

title: Job 21:4
text: As for me, is my outcry against man? is it then to be wondered at if my spirit is troubled?

title: Job 21:5
text: Take note of me and be full of wonder, put your hand on your mouth.

title: Job 21:6
text: At the very thought of it my flesh is shaking with fear.

title: Job 21:7
text: ¶Why is life given to the evil-doers? why do they become old and strong in power?

title: Job 21:8
text: Their children are ever with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

title: Job 21:9
text: Their houses are free from fear, and the rod of God does not come on them.

title: Job 21:10
text: Their ox is ready at all times to give seed; their cow gives birth, without dropping her young.

title: Job 21:11
text: They send out their young ones like a flock, and their children have pleasure in the dance,

title: Job 21:12
text: They make songs to the instruments of music, and are glad at the sound of the pipe.

title: Job 21:13
text: Their days come to an end without trouble, and suddenly they go down to the underworld.

title: Job 21:14
text: Though they said to God, Go away from us, for we have no desire for the knowledge of your ways.

title: Job 21:15
text: What is the Ruler of all, that we may give him worship? and what profit is it to us to make prayer to him?

title: Job 21:16
text: Truly, is not their well-being in their power? (The purpose of the evil-doers is far from me.)

title: Job 21:17
text: ¶How frequently is the light of the evil-doers put out, or does trouble come on them? how frequently does his wrath take them with cords?

title: Job 21:18
text: How frequently are they as dry stems before the wind, or as grass taken away by the storm-wind?

title: Job 21:19
text: You say, God keeps punishment stored up for his children. Let him send it on the man himself, so that he may have the punishment of it!

title: Job 21:20
text: Let his eyes see his trouble, and let him be full of the wrath of the Ruler of all!

title: Job 21:21
text: For what interest has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is ended?

title: Job 21:22
text: Is anyone able to give teaching to God? for he is the judge of those who are on high.

title: Job 21:23
text: One comes to his end in complete well-being, full of peace and quiet:

title: Job 21:24
text: His buckets are full of milk, and there is no loss of strength in his bones.

title: Job 21:25
text: And another comes to his end with a bitter soul, without ever tasting good.

title: Job 21:26
text: Together they go down to the dust, and are covered by the worm.

title: Job 21:27
text: ¶See, I am conscious of your thoughts, and of your violent purposes against me;

title: Job 21:28
text: For you say, Where is the house of the ruler, and where is the tent of the evil-doer?

title: Job 21:29
text: Have you not put the question to the travellers, and do you not take note of their experience?

title: Job 21:30
text: How the evil man goes free in the day of trouble, and has salvation in the day of wrath?

title: Job 21:31
text: Who will make his way clear to his face? and if he has done a thing, who gives him punishment for it?

title: Job 21:32
text: He is taken to his last resting-place, and keeps watch over it.

title: Job 21:33
text: The earth of the valley covering his bones is sweet to him, and all men come after him, as there were unnumbered before him.

title: Job 21:34
text: Why then do you give me comfort with words in which there is no profit, when you see that there is nothing in your answers but deceit?

title: Job 22:1
text: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

title: Job 22:2
text: Is it possible for a man to be of profit to God? No, for a man's wisdom is only of profit to himself.

title: Job 22:3
text: Is it of any interest to the Ruler of all that you are upright? or is it of use to him that your ways are without sin?

title: Job 22:4
text: Is it because you give him honour that he is sending punishment on you and is judging you?

title: Job 22:5
text: ¶Is not your evil-doing great? and there is no end to your sins.

title: Job 22:6
text: For you have taken your brother's goods when he was not in your debt, and have taken away the clothing of those who have need of it.

title: Job 22:7
text: You do not give water to the tired traveller, and from him who has no food you keep back bread.

title: Job 22:8
text: For it was the man with power who had the land, and the man with an honoured name who was living in it.

title: Job 22:9
text: You have sent widows away without hearing their cause, and you have taken away the support of the child who has no father.

title: Job 22:10
text: For this cause nets are round your feet, and you are overcome with sudden fear.

title: Job 22:11
text: Your light is made dark so that you are unable to see, and you are covered by a mass of waters.

title: Job 22:12
text: Is not God as high as heaven? and see the stars, how high they are!

title: Job 22:13
text: And you say, What knowledge has God? is he able to give decisions through the deep dark?

title: Job 22:14
text: Thick clouds are covering him, so that he is unable to see; and he is walking on the arch of heaven.

title: Job 22:15
text: ¶Will you keep the old way by which evil men went?

title: Job 22:16
text: Who were violently taken away before their time, who were overcome by the rush of waters:

title: Job 22:17
text: Who said to God, Go away from us; and, What is the Ruler of all able to do to us?

title: Job 22:18
text: Though he made their houses full of good things: but the purpose of the evil-doers is far from me!

title: Job 22:19
text: The upright saw it and were glad: and those who had done no wrong made sport of them,

title: Job 22:20
text: Saying, Truly, their substance is cut off, and their wealth is food for the fire.

title: Job 22:21
text: ¶Put yourself now in a right relation with him and be at peace: so will you do well in your undertakings.

title: Job 22:22
text: Be pleased to take teaching from his mouth, and let his words be stored up in your heart.

title: Job 22:23
text: If you come back to the Ruler of all, making yourself low before him; if you put evil far away from your tents;

title: Job 22:24
text: And put your gold in the dust, even your gold of Ophir among the rocks of the valleys;

title: Job 22:25
text: Then the Ruler of all will be your gold, and his teaching will be your silver;

title: Job 22:26
text: For then you will have delight in the Ruler of all, and your face will be lifted up to God.

title: Job 22:27
text: You will make your prayer to him, and be answered; and you will give effect to your oaths.

title: Job 22:28
text: Your purposes will come about, and light will be shining on your ways.

title: Job 22:29
text: For God makes low those whose hearts are lifted up, but he is a saviour to the poor in spirit.

title: Job 22:30
text: He makes safe the man who is free from sin, and if your hands are clean, salvation will be yours.

title: Job 23:1
text: ¶And Job made answer and said,

title: Job 23:2
text: Even today my outcry is bitter; his hand is hard on my sorrow.

title: Job 23:3
text: If only I had knowledge of where he might be seen, so that I might come even to his seat!

title: Job 23:4
text: I would put my cause in order before him, and my mouth would be full of arguments.

title: Job 23:5
text: I would see what his answers would be, and have knowledge of what he would say to me.

title: Job 23:6
text: Would he make use of his great power to overcome me? No, but he would give attention to me.

title: Job 23:7
text: There an upright man might put his cause before him; and I would be free for ever from my judge.

title: Job 23:8
text: ¶See, I go forward, but he is not there; and back, but I do not see him;

title: Job 23:9
text: I am looking for him on the left hand, but there is no sign of him; and turning to the right, I am not able to see him.

title: Job 23:10
text: For he has knowledge of the way I take; after I have been tested I will come out like gold.

title: Job 23:11
text: My feet have gone in his steps; I have kept in his way, without turning to one side or to the other.

title: Job 23:12
text: I have never gone against the orders of his lips; the words of his mouth have been stored up in my heart.

title: Job 23:13
text: ¶But his purpose is fixed and there is no changing it; and he gives effect to the desire of his soul.

title: Job 23:14
text: For what has been ordered for me by him will be gone through to the end: and his mind is full of such designs.

title: Job 23:15
text: For this cause I am in fear before him, my thoughts of him overcome me.

title: Job 23:16
text: For God has made my heart feeble, and my mind is troubled before the Ruler of all.

title: Job 23:17
text: For I am overcome by the dark, and by the black night which is covering my face.

title: Job 24:1
text: ¶Why are times not stored up by the Ruler of all, and why do those who have knowledge of him not see his days?

title: Job 24:2
text: The landmarks are changed by evil men, they violently take away flocks, together with their keepers.

title: Job 24:3
text: They send away the ass of him who has no father, they take the widow's ox for debt.

title: Job 24:4
text: The crushed are turned out of the way; all the poor of the earth go into a secret place together.

title: Job 24:5
text: Like asses in the waste land they go out to their work, looking for food with care; from the waste land they get bread for their children.

title: Job 24:6
text: They get mixed grain from the field, and they take away the late fruit from the vines of those who have wealth.

title: Job 24:7
text: They take their rest at night without clothing, and have no cover in the cold.

title: Job 24:8
text: They are wet with the rain of the mountains, and get into the cracks of the rock for cover.

title: Job 24:9
text: The child without a father is forced from its mother's breast, and they take the young children of the poor for debt.

title: Job 24:10
text: Others go about without clothing, and though they have no food, they get in the grain from the fields.

title: Job 24:11
text: Between the lines of olive-trees they make oil; though they have no drink, they are crushing out the grapes.

title: Job 24:12
text: From the town come sounds of pain from those who are near death, and the soul of the wounded is crying out for help; but God does not take note of their prayer.

title: Job 24:13
text: ¶Then there are those who are haters of the light, who have no knowledge of its ways, and do not go in them.

title: Job 24:14
text: He who is purposing death gets up before day, so that he may put to death the poor and those in need.

title: Job 24:15
text: And the man whose desire is for the wife of another is waiting for the evening, saying, No eye will see me; and he puts a cover on his face. And in the night the thief goes about;

title: Job 24:16
text: In the dark he makes holes in the walls of houses: in the daytime they are shutting themselves up, they have no knowledge of the light.

title: Job 24:17
text: For the middle of the night is as morning to them, they are not troubled by the fear of the dark.

title: Job 24:18
text: ¶They go quickly on the face of the waters; their heritage is cursed in the earth; the steps of the crusher of grapes are not turned to their vine-garden.

title: Job 24:19
text: Snow waters become dry with the heat: so do sinners go down into the underworld.

title: Job 24:20
text: The public place of his town has no more knowledge of him, and his name has gone from the memory of men: he is rooted up like a dead tree.

title: Job 24:21
text: He is not kind to the widow, and he has no pity for her child.

title: Job 24:22
text: But God by his power gives long life to the strong; he gets up again, though he has no hope of life.

title: Job 24:23
text: He takes away his fear of danger and gives him support; and his eyes are on his ways.

title: Job 24:24
text: For a short time they are lifted up; then they are gone; they are made low, they are pulled off like fruit, and like the heads of grain they are cut off.

title: Job 24:25
text: And if it is not so, now, who will make it clear that my words are false, and that what I say is of no value?

title: Job 25:1
text: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

title: Job 25:2
text: Rule and power are his; he makes peace in his high places.

title: Job 25:3
text: Is it possible for his armies to be numbered? and on whom is not his light shining?

title: Job 25:4
text: How then is it possible for man to be upright before God? or how may he be clean who is a son of woman?

title: Job 25:5
text: See, even the moon is not bright, and the stars are not clean in his eyes:

title: Job 25:6
text: How much less man who is an insect, and the son of man who is a worm!

title: Job 26:1
text: ¶Then Job made answer and said,

title: Job 26:2
text: How have you given help to him who has no power! how have you been the salvation of the arm which has no strength!

title: Job 26:3
text: How have you given teaching to him who has no wisdom, and fully made clear true knowledge!

title: Job 26:4
text: To whom have your words been said? and whose spirit came out from you?

title: Job 26:5
text: ¶The shades in the underworld are shaking; the waters and those living in them.

title: Job 26:6
text: The underworld is uncovered before him, and Destruction has no veil.

title: Job 26:7
text: By his hand the north is stretched out in space, and the earth is hanging on nothing.

title: Job 26:8
text: By him the waters are shut up in his thick clouds, and the cloud does not give way under them.

title: Job 26:9
text: By him the face of his high seat is veiled, and his cloud stretched out over it.

title: Job 26:10
text: By him a circle is marked out on the face of the waters, to the limits of the light and the dark.

title: Job 26:11
text: The pillars of heaven are shaking, and are overcome by his sharp words.

title: Job 26:12
text: By his power the sea was made quiet; and by his wisdom Rahab was wounded.

title: Job 26:13
text: By his wind the heavens become bright: by his hand the quickly moving snake was cut through.

title: Job 26:14
text: See, these are only the outskirts of his ways; and how small is that which comes to our ears about him! But the thunder of his acts of power is outside all knowledge.

title: Job 27:1
text: ¶And Job again took up the word and said,

title: Job 27:2
text: By the life of God, who has taken away my right; and of the Ruler of all, who has made my soul bitter;

title: Job 27:3
text: (For all my breath is still in me, and the spirit of God is my life;)

title: Job 27:4
text: Truly, there is no deceit in my lips, and my tongue does not say what is false.

title: Job 27:5
text: Let it be far from me! I will certainly not say that you are right! I will come to death before I give up my righteousness.

title: Job 27:6
text: I will keep it safe, and will not let it go: my heart has nothing to say against any part of my life.

title: Job 27:7
text: ¶Let my hater be like the evil man, and let him who comes against me be as the sinner.

title: Job 27:8
text: For what is the hope of the sinner when he is cut off, when God takes back his soul?

title: Job 27:9
text: Will his cry come to the ears of God when he is in trouble?

title: Job 27:10
text: Will he take delight in the Ruler of all, and make his prayer to God at all times?

title: Job 27:11
text: ¶I will give you teaching about the hand of God; I will not keep secret from you what is in the mind of the Ruler of all.

title: Job 27:12
text: Truly, you have all seen it yourselves; why then have you become completely foolish?

title: Job 27:13
text: This is the punishment of the evil-doer from God, and the heritage given to the cruel by the Ruler of all.

title: Job 27:14
text: If his children are increased, it is for the sword; and his offspring have not enough bread.

title: Job 27:15
text: When those of his house who are still living come to their end by disease, they are not put into the earth, and their widows are not weeping for them.

title: Job 27:16
text: Though he may get silver together like dust, and make ready great stores of clothing;

title: Job 27:17
text: He may get them ready, but the upright will put them on, and he who is free from sin will take the silver for a heritage.

title: Job 27:18
text: His house has no more strength than a spider's thread, or a watchman's tent.

title: Job 27:19
text: He goes to rest full of wealth, but does so for the last time: on opening his eyes, he sees it there no longer.

title: Job 27:20
text: Fears overtake him like rushing waters; in the night the storm-wind takes him away.

title: Job 27:21
text: The east wind takes him up and he is gone; he is forced violently out of his place.

title: Job 27:22
text: God sends his arrows against him without mercy; he goes in flight before his hand.

title: Job 27:23
text: Men make signs of joy because of him, driving him from his place with sounds of hissing.

title: Job 28:1
text: ¶Truly there is a mine for silver, and a place where gold is washed out.

title: Job 28:2
text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and stone is changed into brass by the fire.

title: Job 28:3
text: Man puts an end to the dark, searching out to the farthest limit the stones of the deep places of the dark.

title: Job 28:4
text: He makes a deep mine far away from those living in the light of day; when they go about on the earth, they have no knowledge of those who are under them, who are hanging far from men, twisting from side to side on a cord.

title: Job 28:5
text: As for the earth, bread comes out of it; but under its face it is turned up as if by fire.

title: Job 28:6
text: Its stones are the place of sapphires, and it has dust of gold.

title: Job 28:7
text: No bird has knowledge of it, and the hawk's eye has never seen it.

title: Job 28:8
text: The great beasts have not gone over it, and the cruel lion has not taken that way.

title: Job 28:9
text: Man puts out his hand on the hard rock, overturning mountains by the roots.

title: Job 28:10
text: He makes deep ways, cut through the rock, and his eye sees everything of value.

title: Job 28:11
text: He keeps back the streams from flowing, and makes the secret things come out into the light.

title: Job 28:12
text: But where may wisdom be seen? and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

title: Job 28:13
text: Man has not seen the way to it, and it is not in the land of the living.

title: Job 28:14
text: ¶The deep waters say, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.

title: Job 28:15
text: Gold may not be given for it, or a weight of silver in payment for it.

title: Job 28:16
text: It may not be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the onyx of great price, or the sapphire.

title: Job 28:17
text: Gold and glass are not equal to it in price, and it may not be exchanged for jewels of the best gold.

title: Job 28:18
text: There is no need to say anything about coral or crystal; and the value of wisdom is greater than that of pearls.

title: Job 28:19
text: The topaz of Ethiopia is not equal to it, and it may not be valued with the best gold.

title: Job 28:20
text: ¶From where then does wisdom come, and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

title: Job 28:21
text: For it is kept secret from the eyes of all living, unseen by the birds of the air.

title: Job 28:22
text: Destruction and Death say, We have only had word of it with our ears.

title: Job 28:23
text: God has knowledge of the way to it, and of its resting-place;

title: Job 28:24
text: For his eyes go to the ends of the earth, and he sees everything under heaven.

title: Job 28:25
text: When he made a weight for the wind, measuring out the waters;

title: Job 28:26
text: When he made a law for the rain, and a way for the thunder-flames;

title: Job 28:27
text: Then he saw it, and put it on record; he gave it its fixed form, searching it out completely.

title: Job 28:28
text: And he said to man, Truly the fear of the Lord is wisdom, and to keep from evil is the way to knowledge.

title: Job 29:1
text: ¶And Job again took up the word and said,

title: Job 29:2
text: If only I might again be as I was in the months which are past, in the days when God was watching over me!

title: Job 29:3
text: When his light was shining over my head, and when I went through the dark by his light.

title: Job 29:4
text: As I was in my flowering years, when my tent was covered by the hand of God;

title: Job 29:5
text: While the Ruler of all was still with me, and my children were round me;

title: Job 29:6
text: When my steps were washed with milk, and rivers of oil were flowing out of the rock for me.

title: Job 29:7
text: ¶When I went out of my door to go up to the town, and took my seat in the public place,

title: Job 29:8
text: The young men saw me, and went away, and the old men got up from their seats;

title: Job 29:9
text: The rulers kept quiet, and put their hands on their mouths;

title: Job 29:10
text: The chiefs kept back their words, and their tongues were joined to the roofs of their mouths.

title: Job 29:11
text: For when it came to their ears, men said that I was truly happy; and when their eyes saw, they gave witness to me;

title: Job 29:12
text: For I was a saviour to the poor when he was crying for help, to the child with no father, and to him who had no supporter.

title: Job 29:13
text: The blessing of him who was near to destruction came on me, and I put a song of joy into the widow's heart.

title: Job 29:14
text: I put on righteousness as my clothing, and was full of it; right decisions were to me a robe and a head-dress.

title: Job 29:15
text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to him who had no power of walking.

title: Job 29:16
text: I was a father to the poor, searching out the cause of him who was strange to me.

title: Job 29:17
text: By me the great teeth of the evil-doer were broken, and I made him give up what he had violently taken away.

title: Job 29:18
text: ¶Then I said, I will come to my end with my children round me, my days will be as the sand in number;

title: Job 29:19
text: My root will be open to the waters, and the night mist will be on my branches,

title: Job 29:20
text: My glory will be ever new, and my bow will be readily bent in my hand.

title: Job 29:21
text: Men gave ear to me, waiting and keeping quiet for my suggestions.

title: Job 29:22
text: After I had said what was in my mind, they were quiet and let my words go deep into their hearts;

title: Job 29:23
text: They were waiting for me as for the rain, opening their mouths wide as for the spring rains.

title: Job 29:24
text: I was laughing at them when they had no hope, and the light of my face was never clouded by their fear.

title: Job 29:25
text: I took my place as a chief, guiding them on their way, and I was as a king among his army. ...

title: Job 30:1
text: ¶But now those who are younger than I make sport of me; those whose fathers I would not have put with the dogs of my flocks.

title: Job 30:2
text: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me? all force is gone from them.

title: Job 30:3
text: They are wasted for need of food, biting the dry earth; their only hope of life is in the waste land.

title: Job 30:4
text: They are pulling off the salt leaves from the brushwood, and making a meal of roots.

title: Job 30:5
text: They are sent out from among their townsmen, men are crying after them as thieves

title: Job 30:6
text: They have to get a resting-place in the hollows of the valleys, in holes of the earth and rocks.

title: Job 30:7
text: They make noises like asses among the brushwood; they get together under the thorns.

title: Job 30:8
text: They are sons of shame, and of men without a name, who have been forced out of the land.

title: Job 30:9
text: And now I have become their song, and I am a word of shame to them.

title: Job 30:10
text: I am disgusting to them; they keep away from me, and put marks of shame on me.

title: Job 30:11
text: For he has made loose the cord of my bow, and put me to shame; he has sent down my flag to the earth before me.

title: Job 30:12
text: The lines of his men of war put themselves in order, and make high their ways of destruction against me:

title: Job 30:13
text: They have made waste my roads, with a view to my destruction; his bowmen come round about me;

title: Job 30:14
text: As through a wide broken place in the wall they come on, I am overturned by the shock of their attack.

title: Job 30:15
text: ¶Fears have come on me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my well-being like a cloud.

title: Job 30:16
text: But now my soul is turned to water in me, days of trouble overtake me:

title: Job 30:17
text: The flesh is gone from my bones, and they give me no rest; there is no end to my pains.

title: Job 30:18
text: With great force he takes a grip of my clothing, pulling me by the neck of my coat.

title: Job 30:19
text: Truly God has made me low, even to the earth, and I have become like dust.

title: Job 30:20
text: You give no answer to my cry, and take no note of my prayer.

title: Job 30:21
text: You have become cruel to me; the strength of your hand is hard on me.

title: Job 30:22
text: Lifting me up, you make me go on the wings of the wind; I am broken up by the storm.

title: Job 30:23
text: For I am certain that you will send me back to death, and to the meeting-place ordered for all living.

title: Job 30:24
text: Has not my hand been stretched out in help to the poor? have I not been a saviour to him in his trouble?

title: Job 30:25
text: Have I not been weeping for the crushed? and was not my soul sad for him who was in need?

title: Job 30:26
text: For I was looking for good, and evil came; I was waiting for light, and it became dark.

title: Job 30:27
text: My feelings are strongly moved, and give me no rest; days of trouble have overtaken me.

title: Job 30:28
text: I go about in dark clothing, uncomforted; I get up in the public place, crying out for help.

title: Job 30:29
text: I have become a brother to the jackals, and go about in the company of ostriches.

title: Job 30:30
text: My skin is black and dropping off me; and my bones are burning with the heat of my disease.

title: Job 30:31
text: And my music has been turned to sorrow, and the sound of my pipe into the noise of weeping.

title: Job 31:1
text: ¶I made an agreement with my eyes; how then might my eyes be looking on a virgin?

title: Job 31:2
text: For what is God's reward from on high, or the heritage given by the Ruler of all from heaven?

title: Job 31:3
text: Is it not trouble for the sinner, and destruction for the evil-doers?

title: Job 31:4
text: Does he not see my ways, and are not my steps all numbered?

title: Job 31:5
text: If I have gone in false ways, or my foot has been quick in working deceit;

title: Job 31:6
text: (Let me be measured in upright scales, and let God see my righteousness:)

title: Job 31:7
text: If my steps have been turned out of the way, or if my heart went after my eyes, or if the property of another is in my hands;

title: Job 31:8
text: Let me put seed in the earth for another to have the fruit of it, and let my produce be uprooted.

title: Job 31:9
text: ¶If my heart went after another man's wife, or if I was waiting secretly at my neighbour's door;

title: Job 31:10
text: Then let my wife give pleasure to another man and let others make use of her body.

title: Job 31:11
text: For that would be a crime; it would be an act for which punishment would be measured out by the judges:

title: Job 31:12
text: It would be a fire burning even to destruction, and taking away all my produce.

title: Job 31:13
text: If I did wrong in the cause of my man-servant, or my woman-servant, when they went to law with me;

title: Job 31:14
text: What then will I do when God comes as my judge? and what answer may I give to his questions?

title: Job 31:15
text: Did not God make him as well as me? did he not give us life in our mothers' bodies?

title: Job 31:16
text: ¶If I kept back the desire of the poor; if the widow's eye was looking for help to no purpose;

title: Job 31:17
text: If I kept my food for myself, and did not give some of it to the child with no father;

title: Job 31:18
text: (For I was cared for by God as by a father from my earliest days; he was my guide from the body of my mother;)

title: Job 31:19
text: If I saw one near to death for need of clothing, and that the poor had nothing covering him;

title: Job 31:20
text: If his back did not give me a blessing, and the wool of my sheep did not make him warm;

title: Job 31:21
text: If my hand had been lifted up against him who had done no wrong, when I saw that I was supported by the judges;

title: Job 31:22
text: May my arm be pulled from my body, and be broken from its base.

title: Job 31:23
text: For the fear of God kept me back, and because of his power I might not do such things.

title: Job 31:24
text: ¶If I made gold my hope, or if I ever said to the best gold, I have put my faith in you;

title: Job 31:25
text: If I was glad because my wealth was great, and because my hand had got together a great store;

title: Job 31:26
text: If, when I saw the sun shining, and the moon moving on its bright way,

title: Job 31:27
text: A secret feeling of worship came into my heart, and my hand gave kisses from my mouth;

title: Job 31:28
text: That would have been another sin to be rewarded with punishment by the judges; for I would have been false to God on high.

title: Job 31:29
text: If I was glad at the trouble of my hater, and gave cries of joy when evil overtook him;

title: Job 31:30
text: (For I did not let my mouth give way to sin, in putting a curse on his life;)

title: Job 31:31
text: If the men of my tent did not say, Who has not had full measure of his meat?

title: Job 31:32
text: The traveller did not take his night's rest in the street, and my doors were open to anyone on a journey;

title: Job 31:33
text: ¶If I kept my evil doings covered, and my sin in the secret of my breast,

title: Job 31:34
text: For fear of the great body of people, or for fear that families might make sport of me, so that I kept quiet, and did not go out of my door;

title: Job 31:35
text: If only God would give ear to me, and the Ruler of all would give me an answer! or if what he has against me had been put in writing!

title: Job 31:36
text: Truly I would take up the book in my hands; it would be to me as a crown;

title: Job 31:37
text: I would make clear the number of my steps, I would put it before him like a prince! The words of Job are ended.

title: Job 31:38
text: If my land has made an outcry against me, or the ploughed earth has been in sorrow;

title: Job 31:39
text: If I have taken its produce without payment, causing the death of its owners;

title: Job 31:40
text: Then in place of grain let thorns come up, and in place of barley evil-smelling plants.

title: Job 32:1
text: ¶So these three men gave no more answers to Job, because he seemed to himself to be right.

title: Job 32:2
text: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was angry, burning with wrath against Job, because he seemed to himself more right than God;

title: Job 32:3
text: And he was angry with his three friends, because they had been unable to give him an answer, and had not made Job's sin clear.

title: Job 32:4
text: Now Elihu had kept quiet while Job was talking, because they were older than he;

title: Job 32:5
text: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, he was very angry.

title: Job 32:6
text: ¶And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, made answer and said, I am young, and you are very old, so I was in fear, and kept myself from putting my knowledge before you.

title: Job 32:7
text: I said to myself, It is right for the old to say what is in their minds, and for those who are far on in years to give out wisdom.

title: Job 32:8
text: But truly it is the spirit in man, even the breath of the Ruler of all, which gives them knowledge.

title: Job 32:9
text: It is not the old who are wise, and those who are full of years have not the knowledge of what is right.

title: Job 32:10
text: So I say, Give ear to me, and I will put forward my knowledge.

title: Job 32:11
text: I was waiting for your words, I was giving ear to your wise sayings; while you were searching out what to say,

title: Job 32:12
text: I was taking note; and truly not one of you was able to make clear Job's error, or to give an answer to his words.

title: Job 32:13
text: Take care that you do not say, Wisdom is here; God may overcome him, but not man.

title: Job 32:14
text: I will not put forward words like these, or make use of your sayings in answer to him.

title: Job 32:15
text: ¶Fear has overcome them, they have no more answers to give; they have come to an end of words.

title: Job 32:16
text: And am I to go on waiting while they have nothing to say? while they keep quiet and give no more answers?

title: Job 32:17
text: I will give my answer; I will put forward my knowledge:

title: Job 32:18
text: For I am full of words, I am unable to keep in my breath any longer:

title: Job 32:19
text: My stomach is like wine which is unable to get out; like skins full of new wine, it is almost burst.

title: Job 32:20
text: Let me say what is in my mind, so that I may get comfort; let me give answer with open mouth.

title: Job 32:21
text: Let me not give respect to any man, or give names of honour to any living.

title: Job 32:22
text: For I am not able to give names of honour to any man; and if I did, my Maker would quickly take me away.

title: Job 33:1
text: ¶And now, O Job, give ear to my words, and take note of all I say.

title: Job 33:2
text: See, now my mouth is open, my tongue gives out words.

title: Job 33:3
text: My heart is overflowing with knowledge, my lips say what is true.

title: Job 33:4
text: The spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Ruler of all gives me life.

title: Job 33:5
text: If you are able, give me an answer; put your cause in order, and come forward.

title: Job 33:6
text: See, I am the same as you are in the eyes of God; I was cut off from the same bit of wet earth.

title: Job 33:7
text: Fear of me will not overcome you, and my hand will not be hard on you.

title: Job 33:8
text: ¶But you said in my hearing, and your voice came to my ears:

title: Job 33:9
text: I am clean, without sin; I am washed, and there is no evil in me:

title: Job 33:10
text: See, he is looking for something against me; in his eyes I am as one of his haters;

title: Job 33:11
text: He puts chains on my feet; he is watching all my ways.

title: Job 33:12
text: Truly, in saying this you are wrong; for God is greater than man.

title: Job 33:13
text: Why do you put forward your cause against him, saying, He gives no answer to any of my words?

title: Job 33:14
text: ¶For God gives his word in one way, even in two, and man is not conscious of it:

title: Job 33:15
text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep comes on men, while they take their rest on their beds;

title: Job 33:16
text: Then he makes his secrets clear to men, so that they are full of fear at what they see;

title: Job 33:17
text: In order that man may be turned from his evil works, and that pride may be taken away from him;

title: Job 33:18
text: To keep back his soul from the underworld, and his life from destruction.

title: Job 33:19
text: ¶Pain is sent on him as a punishment, while he is on his bed; there is no end to the trouble in his bones;

title: Job 33:20
text: He has no desire for food, and his soul is turned away from delicate meat;

title: Job 33:21
text: His flesh is so wasted away, that it may not be seen, and his bones. ...

title: Job 33:22
text: And his soul comes near to the underworld, and his life to the angels of death.

title: Job 33:23
text: If now there may be an angel sent to him, one of the thousands which there are to be between him and God, and to make clear to man what is right for him;

title: Job 33:24
text: And if he has mercy on him, and says, Let him not go down to the underworld, I have given the price for his life:

title: Job 33:25
text: Then his flesh becomes young again, and he comes back to the days of his early strength;

title: Job 33:26
text: He makes his prayer to God, and he has mercy on him; he sees God's face with cries of joy; he gives news of his righteousness to men;

title: Job 33:27
text: He makes a song, saying, I did wrong, turning from the straight way, but he did not give me the reward of my sin.

title: Job 33:28
text: He kept my soul from the underworld, and my life sees the light in full measure.

title: Job 33:29
text: ¶Truly, God does all these things to man, twice and three times,

title: Job 33:30
text: Keeping back his soul from the underworld, so that he may see the light of life.

title: Job 33:31
text: Take note O Job, give ear to me; keep quiet, while I say what is in my mind.

title: Job 33:32
text: If you have anything to say, give me an answer; for it is my desire that you may be judged free from sin.

title: Job 33:33
text: If not, give attention to me, and keep quiet, and I will give you wisdom.

title: Job 34:1
text: ¶And Elihu made answer and said,

title: Job 34:2
text: Give ear, you wise, to my words; and you who have knowledge, give attention to me;

title: Job 34:3
text: For words are tested by the ear, as food is tasted by the mouth.

title: Job 34:4
text: Let us make the decision for ourselves as to what is right; let us have the knowledge among ourselves of what is good.

title: Job 34:5
text: For Job has said, I am upright, and it is God who has taken away my right;

title: Job 34:6
text: Though I am right, still I am in pain; my wound may not be made well, though I have done no wrong.

title: Job 34:7
text: What man is like Job, a man who freely makes sport of God,

title: Job 34:8
text: And goes in the company of evil-doers, walking in the way of sinners?

title: Job 34:9
text: For he has said, It is no profit to a man to take delight in God.

title: Job 34:10
text: ¶Now then, you wise, take note; you men of knowledge, give ear to me. Let it be far from God to do evil, and from the Ruler of all to do wrong.

title: Job 34:11
text: For he gives to every man the reward of his work, and sees that he gets the fruit of his ways.

title: Job 34:12
text: Truly, God does not do evil, and the Ruler of all is not a false judge.

title: Job 34:13
text: Who put the earth into his care, or made him responsible for the world?

title: Job 34:14
text: If he made his spirit come back to him, taking his breath into himself again,

title: Job 34:15
text: All flesh would come to an end together, and man would go back to the dust.

title: Job 34:16
text: ¶If you are wise, take note of this; give ear to the voice of my words.

title: Job 34:17
text: How may a hater of right be a ruler? and will you say that the upright Ruler of all is evil?

title: Job 34:18
text: He who says to a king, You are an evil-doer; and to rulers, You are sinners;

title: Job 34:19
text: Who has no respect for rulers, and who gives no more attention to those who have wealth than to the poor, for they are all the work of his hands.

title: Job 34:20
text: Suddenly they come to an end, even in the middle of the night: the blow comes on the men of wealth, and they are gone, and the strong are taken away without the hand of man.

title: Job 34:21
text: For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps.

title: Job 34:22
text: There is no dark place, and no thick cloud, in which the workers of evil may take cover.

title: Job 34:23
text: For he does not give man a fixed time to come before him to be judged.

title: Job 34:24
text: He sends the strong to destruction without searching out their cause, and puts others in their place.

title: Job 34:25
text: For he has knowledge of their works, overturning them in the night, so that they are crushed.

title: Job 34:26
text: The evil-doers are broken by his wrath, he puts his hand on them with force before the eyes of all onlookers.

title: Job 34:27
text: Because they did not go after him, and took no note of his ways,

title: Job 34:28
text: So that the cry of the poor might come up to him, and the prayer of those in need come to his ears.

title: Job 34:34
text: Men of knowledge, and all wise men, hearing me, will say,

title: Job 34:35
text: Job's words do not come from knowledge; they are not the fruit of wisdom.

title: Job 34:36
text: May Job be tested to the end, because his answers have been like those of evil men.

title: Job 34:37
text: For in addition to his sin, he is uncontrolled in heart; before our eyes he makes sport of God, increasing his words against him.

title: Job 35:1
text: ¶And Elihu made answer and said,

title: Job 35:2
text: Does it seem to you to be right, and righteousness before God, to say,

title: Job 35:3
text: What profit is it to me, and how am I better off than if I had done wrong?

title: Job 35:4
text: I will make answer to you and to your friends:

title: Job 35:5
text: Let your eyes be turned to the heavens, and lifted up to see the skies; they are higher than you.

title: Job 35:6
text: If you have done wrong, is he any the worse for it? and if your sins are great in number, what is it to him?

title: Job 35:7
text: If you are upright, what do you give to him? or what does he take from your hand?

title: Job 35:8
text: Your evil-doing may have an effect on a man like yourself, or your righteousness on a son of man.

title: Job 35:9
text: ¶Because the hand of the cruel is hard on them, men are making sounds of grief; they are crying out for help because of the arm of the strong.

title: Job 35:10
text: But no one has said, Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night;

title: Job 35:11
text: Who gives us more knowledge than the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heaven?

title: Job 35:12
text: There they are crying out because of the pride of the evil-doers, but he gives them no answer.

title: Job 35:13
text: But God will not give ear to what is false, or the Ruler of all take note of it;

title: Job 35:14
text: ¶How much less when you say that you do not see him; that the cause is before him, and you are waiting for him.

title: Job 35:15
text: And now...;

title: Job 35:16
text: And Job's mouth is open wide to give out what is of no profit, increasing words without knowledge.

title: Job 36:1
text: ¶And Elihu went on to say,

title: Job 36:2
text: Give me a little more time, and I will make it clear to you; for I have still something to say for God.

title: Job 36:3
text: I will get my knowledge from far, and I will give righteousness to my Maker.

title: Job 36:4
text: For truly my words are not false; one who has all knowledge is talking with you.

title: Job 36:5
text: ¶Truly, God gives up the hard-hearted, and will not give life to the sinner.

title: Job 36:6
text: His eyes are ever on the upright, and he gives to the crushed their right;

title: Job 36:7
text: Lifting them up to the seat of kings, and making them safe for ever.

title: Job 36:8
text: And if they have been prisoned in chains, and taken in cords of trouble,

title: Job 36:9
text: Then he makes clear to them what they have done, even their evil works in which they have taken pride.

title: Job 36:10
text: Their ear is open to his teaching, and he gives them orders so that their hearts may be turned from evil.

title: Job 36:11
text: If they give ear to his voice, and do his word, then he gives them long life, and years full of pleasure.

title: Job 36:12
text: But if not, they come to their end, and give up their breath without knowledge.

title: Job 36:13
text: Those who have no fear of God keep wrath stored up in their hearts; they give no cry for help when they are made prisoners.

title: Job 36:14
text: They come to their end while they are still young, their life is short like that of those who are used for sex purposes in the worship of their gods.

title: Job 36:15
text: ¶He makes the wrong done to the poor the way of their salvation, opening their ears by their trouble.

title: Job 36:21
text: Take care not to be turned to sin, for you have taken evil for your part in place of sorrow.

title: Job 36:22
text: Truly God is lifted up in strength; who is a ruler like him?

title: Job 36:23
text: Who ever gave orders to him, or said to him, You have done wrong?

title: Job 36:24
text: ¶See that you give praise to his work, about which men make songs.

title: Job 36:25
text: All people are looking on it; man sees it from far.

title: Job 36:26
text: Truly, God is great, greater than all our knowledge; the number of his years may not be searched out.

title: Job 36:27
text: For he takes up the drops from the sea; he sends them through his mist as rain,

title: Job 36:28
text: Flowing down from the sky, and dropping on the peoples.

title: Job 36:29
text: And who has knowledge of how the clouds are stretched out, or of the thunders of his tent?

title: Job 36:30
text: See, he is stretching out his mist, covering the tops of the mountains with it.

title: Job 36:31
text: For by these he gives food to the peoples, and bread in full measure.

title: Job 36:32
text: He takes the light in his hands, sending it against the mark.

title: Job 36:33
text: The thunder makes clear his passion, and the storm gives news of his wrath.

title: Job 37:1
text: ¶At this my heart is shaking; it is moved out of its place.

title: Job 37:2
text: Give ear to the rolling noise of his voice; to the hollow sound which goes out of his mouth.

title: Job 37:3
text: He sends it out through all the heaven, and his thunder-flame to the ends of the earth.

title: Job 37:4
text: After it a voice is sounding, thundering out the word of his power; he does not keep back his thunder-flames; from his mouth his voice is sounding.

title: Job 37:5
text: He does wonders, more than may be searched out; great things of which we have no knowledge;

title: Job 37:6
text: ¶For he says to the snow, Make the earth wet; and to the rain-storm, Come down.

title: Job 37:7
text: He puts an end to the work of every man, so that all may see his work.

title: Job 37:8
text: Then the beasts go into their holes, and take their rest.

title: Job 37:9
text: Out of its place comes the storm-wind, and the cold out of its store-houses.

title: Job 37:10
text: By the breath of God ice is made, and the wide waters are shut in.

title: Job 37:11
text: The thick cloud is weighted with thunder-flame, and the cloud sends out its light;

title: Job 37:12
text: And it goes this way and that, round about, turning itself by his guiding, to do whatever he gives orders to be done, on the face of his world of men,

title: Job 37:13
text: For a rod, or for a curse, or for mercy, causing it to come on the mark.

title: Job 37:14
text: ¶Give ear to this, O Job, and keep quiet in your place; and take note of the wonders worked by God.

title: Job 37:15
text: Have you knowledge of God's ordering of his works, how he makes the light of his cloud to be seen?

title: Job 37:16
text: Have you knowledge of the balancings of the clouds, the wonders of him who has all wisdom?

title: Job 37:17
text: You, whose clothing is warm, when the earth is quiet because of the south wind,

title: Job 37:18
text: Will you, with him, make the skies smooth, and strong as a polished looking-glass?

title: Job 37:19
text: Make clear to me what we are to say to him; we are unable to put our cause before him, because of the dark.

title: Job 37:20
text: How may he have knowledge of my desire for talk with him? or did any man ever say, May destruction come on me?

title: Job 37:21
text: ¶And now the light is not seen, for it is dark because of the clouds; but a wind comes, clearing them away.

title: Job 37:22
text: A bright light comes out of the north; God's glory is greatly to be feared.

title: Job 37:23
text: There is no searching out of the Ruler of all: his strength and his judging are great; he is full of righteousness, doing no wrong.

title: Job 37:24
text: For this cause men go in fear of him; he has no respect for any who are wise in heart.

title: Job 38:1
text: ¶And the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

title: Job 38:2
text: Who is this who makes the purpose of God dark by words without knowledge?

title: Job 38:3
text: Get your strength together like a man of war; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

title: Job 38:4
text: ¶Where were you when I put the earth on its base? Say, if you have knowledge.

title: Job 38:5
text: By whom were its measures fixed? Say, if you have wisdom; or by whom was the line stretched out over it?

title: Job 38:6
text: On what were its pillars based, or who put down its angle-stone,

title: Job 38:7
text: When the morning stars made songs together, and all the sons of the gods gave cries of joy?

title: Job 38:8
text: Or where were you when the sea came to birth, pushing out from its secret place;

title: Job 38:9
text: When I made the cloud its robe, and put thick clouds as bands round it,

title: Job 38:10
text: Ordering a fixed limit for it, with locks and doors;

title: Job 38:11
text: And said, So far you may come, and no farther; and here the pride of your waves will be stopped?

title: Job 38:12
text: ¶Have you, from your earliest days, given orders to the morning, or made the dawn conscious of its place;

title: Job 38:13
text: So that it might take a grip of the skirts of the earth, shaking all the evil-doers out of it?

title: Job 38:14
text: It is changed like wet earth under a stamp, and is coloured like a robe;

title: Job 38:15
text: And from the evil-doers their light is kept back, and the arm of pride is broken.

title: Job 38:16
text: Have you come into the springs of the sea, walking in the secret places of the deep?

title: Job 38:17
text: Have the doors of death been open to you, or have the door-keepers of the dark ever seen you?

title: Job 38:18
text: Have you taken note of the wide limits of the earth? Say, if you have knowledge of it all.

title: Job 38:19
text: Which is the way to the resting-place of the light, and where is the store-house of the dark;

title: Job 38:20
text: So that you might take it to its limit, guiding it to its house?

title: Job 38:21
text: No doubt you have knowledge of it, for then you had come to birth, and the number of your days is great.

title: Job 38:22
text: Have you come into the secret place of snow, or have you seen the store-houses of the ice-drops,

title: Job 38:23
text: Which I have kept for the time of trouble, for the day of war and fighting?

title: Job 38:24
text: Which is the way to the place where the wind is measured out, and the east wind sent out over the earth?

title: Job 38:25
text: ¶By whom has the way been cut for the flowing of the rain, and the flaming of the thunder;

title: Job 38:26
text: Causing rain to come on a land where no man is living, on the waste land which has no people;

title: Job 38:27
text: To give water to the land where there is waste and destruction, and to make the dry land green with young grass?

title: Job 38:28
text: Has the rain a father? or who gave birth to the drops of night mist?

title: Job 38:29
text: Out of whose body came the ice? and who gave birth to the cold mist of heaven?

title: Job 38:30
text: The waters are joined together, hard as a stone, and the face of the deep is covered.

title: Job 38:31
text: Are the bands of the Pleiades fixed by you, or are the cords of Orion made loose?

title: Job 38:32
text: Do you make Mazzaroth come out in its right time, or are the Bear and its children guided by you?

title: Job 38:33
text: Have you knowledge of the laws of the heavens? did you give them rule over the earth?

title: Job 38:34
text: Is your voice sent up to the cloud, so that you may be covered by the weight of waters?

title: Job 38:35
text: Do you send out the thunder-flames, so that they may go, and say to you, Here we are?

title: Job 38:36
text: Who has put wisdom in the high clouds, or given knowledge to the lights of the north?

title: Job 38:37
text: By whose wisdom are the clouds numbered, or the water-skins of the heavens turned to the earth,

title: Job 38:38
text: When the earth becomes hard as metal, and is joined together in masses?

title: Job 38:39
text: Do you go after food for the she-lion, or get meat so that the young lions may have enough,

title: Job 38:40
text: When they are stretched out in their holes, and are waiting in the brushwood?

title: Job 38:41
text: Who gives in the evening the meat he is searching for, when his young ones are crying to God; when the young lions with loud noise go wandering after their food?

title: Job 39:1
text: ¶Have you knowledge of the rock-goats? or do you see the roes giving birth to their young?

title: Job 39:2
text: Is the number of their months fixed by you? or is the time when they give birth ordered by you?

title: Job 39:3
text: They are bent down, they give birth to their young, they let loose the fruit of their body.

title: Job 39:4
text: Their young ones are strong, living in the open country; they go out and do not come back again.

title: Job 39:5
text: Who has let the ass of the fields go free? or made loose the bands of the loud-voiced beast?

title: Job 39:6
text: To whom I have given the waste land for a heritage, and the salt land as a living-place.

title: Job 39:7
text: He makes sport of the noise of the town; the voice of the driver does not come to his ears;

title: Job 39:8
text: He goes looking for his grass-lands in the mountains, searching out every green thing.

title: Job 39:9
text: Will the ox of the mountains be your servant? or is his night's resting-place by your food-store?

title: Job 39:10
text: Will he be pulling your plough with cords, turning up the valleys after you?

title: Job 39:11
text: Will you put your faith in him, because his strength is great? will you give the fruit of your work into his care?

title: Job 39:12
text: Will you be looking for him to come back, and get in your seed to the crushing-floor?

title: Job 39:13
text: ¶Is the wing of the ostrich feeble, or is it because she has no feathers,

title: Job 39:14
text: That she puts her eggs on the earth, warming them in the dust,

title: Job 39:15
text: Without a thought that they may be crushed by the foot, and broken by the beasts of the field?

title: Job 39:16
text: She is cruel to her young ones, as if they were not hers; her work is to no purpose; she has no fear.

title: Job 39:17
text: For God has taken wisdom from her mind, and given her no measure of knowledge.

title: Job 39:18
text: When she is shaking her wings on high, she makes sport of the horse and of him who is seated on him.

title: Job 39:19
text: ¶Do you give strength to the horse? is it by your hand that his neck is clothed with power?

title: Job 39:20
text: Is it through you that he is shaking like a locust, in the pride of his loud-sounding breath?

title: Job 39:21
text: He is stamping with joy in the valley; he makes sport of fear.

title: Job 39:22
text: In his strength he goes out against the arms of war, turning not away from the sword.

title: Job 39:23
text: The bow is sounding against him; he sees the shining point of spear and arrow.

title: Job 39:24
text: Shaking with passion, he is biting the earth; he is not able to keep quiet at the sound of the horn;

title: Job 39:25
text: When it comes to his ears he says, Aha! He is smelling the fight from far off, and hearing the thunder of the captains, and the war-cries.

title: Job 39:26
text: ¶Is it through your knowledge that the hawk takes his flight, stretching out his wings to the south?

title: Job 39:27
text: Or is it by your orders that the eagle goes up, and makes his resting-place on high?

title: Job 39:28
text: On the rock is his house, and on the mountain-top his strong place.

title: Job 39:29
text: From there he is watching for food; his eye sees it far off.

title: Job 39:30
text: His young have blood for their drink, and where the dead bodies are, there is he to be seen.

title: Job 40:2
text: Will he who is protesting give teaching to the Ruler of all? Let him who has arguments to put forward against God give an answer.

title: Job 40:3
text: And Job said in answer to the Lord,

title: Job 40:4
text: Truly, I am of no value; what answer may I give to you? I will put my hand on my mouth.

title: Job 40:5
text: I have said once, and even twice, what was in my mind, but I will not do so again.

title: Job 40:6
text: ¶Then the Lord made answer to Job out of the storm-wind, and said,

title: Job 40:7
text: Get your strength together like a man of war: I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

title: Job 40:8
text: Will you even make my right of no value? will you say that I am wrong in order to make clear that you are right?

title: Job 40:9
text: Have you an arm like God? have you a voice of thunder like his?

title: Job 40:10
text: Put on the ornaments of your pride; be clothed with glory and power:

title: Job 40:11
text: Let your wrath be overflowing; let your eyes see all the sons of pride, and make them low.

title: Job 40:12
text: Send destruction on all who are lifted up, pulling down the sinners from their places.

title: Job 40:13
text: Let them be covered together in the dust; let their faces be dark in the secret place of the underworld.

title: Job 40:14
text: Then I will give praise to you, saying that your right hand is able to give you salvation.

title: Job 40:15
text: ¶See now the Great Beast, whom I made, even as I made you; he takes grass for food, like the ox.

title: Job 40:16
text: His strength is in his body, and his force in the muscles of his stomach.

title: Job 40:17
text: His tail is curving like a cedar; the muscles of his legs are joined together.

title: Job 40:18
text: His bones are pipes of brass, his legs are like rods of iron.

title: Job 40:19
text: He is the chief of the ways of God, made by him for his pleasure.

title: Job 40:20
text: He takes the produce of the mountains, where all the beasts of the field are at play.

title: Job 40:21
text: He takes his rest under the trees of the river, and in the pool, under the shade of the water-plants.

title: Job 40:22
text: He is covered by the branches of the trees; the grasses of the stream are round him.

title: Job 40:23
text: Truly, if the river is overflowing, it gives him no cause for fear; he has no sense of danger, even if Jordan is rushing against his mouth.

title: Job 40:24
text: Will anyone take him when he is on the watch, or put metal teeth through his nose?

title: Job 41:1
text: ¶Is it possible for Leviathan to be pulled out with a fish-hook, or for a hook to be put through the bone of his mouth?

title: Job 41:2
text: Will you put a cord into his nose, or take him away with a cord round his tongue?

title: Job 41:3
text: Will he make prayers to you, or say soft words to you?

title: Job 41:4
text: Will he make an agreement with you, so that you may take him as a servant for ever?

title: Job 41:5
text: Will you make sport with him, as with a bird? or put him in chains for your young women?

title: Job 41:6
text: Will the fishermen make profit out of him? will they have him cut up for the traders?

title: Job 41:7
text: Will you put sharp-pointed irons into his skin, or fish-spears into his head?

title: Job 41:8
text: Only put your hand on him, and see what a fight you will have; you will not do it again!

title: Job 41:9
text: Truly, the hope of his attacker is false; he is overcome even on seeing him!

title: Job 41:10
text: He is so cruel that no one is ready to go against him. Who then is able to keep his place before me?

title: Job 41:11
text: ¶Who ever went against me, and got the better of me? There is no one under heaven!

title: Job 41:12
text: I will not keep quiet about the parts of his body, or about his power, and the strength of his frame.

title: Job 41:13
text: Who has ever taken off his outer skin? who may come inside his inner coat of iron?

title: Job 41:14
text: Who has made open the doors of his face? Fear is round about his teeth.

title: Job 41:15
text: His back is made of lines of plates, joined tight together, one against the other, like a stamp.

title: Job 41:16
text: One is so near to the other that no air may come between them.

title: Job 41:17
text: They take a grip of one another; they are joined together, so that they may not be parted.

title: Job 41:18
text: His sneezings give out flames, and his eyes are like the eyes of the dawn.

title: Job 41:19
text: Out of his mouth go burning lights, and flames of fire are jumping up.

title: Job 41:20
text: Smoke comes out of his nose, like a pot boiling on the fire.

title: Job 41:21
text: His breath puts fire to coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

title: Job 41:22
text: Strength is in his neck, and fear goes dancing before him.

title: Job 41:23
text: The plates of his flesh are joined together, fixed, and not to be moved.

title: Job 41:24
text: His heart is as strong as a stone, hard as the lower crushing-stone.

title: Job 41:25
text: When he gets ready for the fight, the strong are overcome with fear.

title: Job 41:26
text: The sword may come near him but is not able to go through him; the spear, or the arrow, or the sharp-pointed iron.

title: Job 41:27
text: Iron is to him as dry grass, and brass as soft wood.

title: Job 41:28
text: The arrow is not able to put him to flight: stones are no more to him than dry stems.

title: Job 41:29
text: A thick stick is no better than a leaf of grass, and he makes sport of the onrush of the spear.

title: Job 41:30
text: Under him are sharp edges of broken pots: as if he was pulling a grain-crushing instrument over the wet earth.

title: Job 41:31
text: The deep is boiling like a pot of spices, and the sea like a perfume-vessel.

title: Job 41:32
text: After him his way is shining, so that the deep seems white.

title: Job 41:33
text: On earth there is not another like him, who is made without fear.

title: Job 41:34
text: Everything which is high goes in fear of him; he is king over all the sons of pride.

title: Job 42:1
text: ¶And Job said in answer to the Lord,

title: Job 42:2
text: I see that you are able to do every thing, and to give effect to all your designs.

title: Job 42:3
text: Who is this who makes dark the purpose of God by words without knowledge? For I have been talking without knowledge about wonders not to be searched out.

title: Job 42:4
text: Give ear to me, and I will say what is in my mind; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.

title: Job 42:5
text: Word of you had come to my ears, but now my eye has seen you.

title: Job 42:6
text: For this cause I give witness that what I said is false, and in sorrow I take my seat in the dust.

title: Job 42:7
text: ¶And it came about, after he had said these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, I am very angry with you and your two friends, because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.

title: Job 42:8
text: And now, take seven oxen and seven sheep, and go to my servant Job, and give a burned offering for yourselves, and my servant Job will make prayer for you, that I may not send punishment on you; because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.

title: Job 42:9
text: And Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, went and did as the Lord had said. And the Lord gave ear to Job.

title: Job 42:10
text: ¶And the Lord made up to Job for all his losses, after he had made prayer for his friends: and all Job had before was increased by the Lord twice as much.

title: Job 42:11
text: And all his brothers and sisters, and his friends of earlier days, came and took food with him in his house; and made clear their grief for him, and gave him comfort for all the evil which the Lord had sent on him; and they all gave him a bit of money and a gold ring.

title: Job 42:12
text: And the Lord's blessing was greater on the end of Job's life than on its start: and so he came to have fourteen thousand sheep and goats, and six thousand camels, and two thousand oxen, and a thousand she-asses.

title: Job 42:13
text: And he had seven sons and three daughters.

title: Job 42:14
text: And he gave the first the name of Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch;

title: Job 42:15
text: And there were no women so beautiful as the daughters of Job in all the earth: and their father gave them a heritage among their brothers.

title: Job 42:16
text: And after this Job had a hundred and forty years of life, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

title: Job 42:17
text: And Job came to his end, old and full of days.

title: Psalms 1:1
text: ¶Happy is the man who does not go in the company of sinners, or take his place in the way of evil-doers, or in the seat of those who do not give honour to the Lord.

title: Psalms 1:2
text: But whose delight is in the law of the Lord, and whose mind is on his law day and night.

title: Psalms 1:3
text: He will be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, which gives its fruit at the right time, whose leaves will ever be green; and he will do well in all his undertakings.

title: Psalms 1:4
